parent.bounded_DB_positive: Both independently 12-task meta-trained two-motif constructors tied 64/64 on sourcefree holdouts, no novel primitive types.

objective: Without enumerating heldout primitive types as templates, learn binary universal gates from separate meta task source observations and infer the truth table and wiring for newly heldout three-input Boolean causal operators; construct a reusable circuit from learned gates; compare equally meta-trained grammar-agnostic peer and bounded two-input historical control.

structural_holdout.true_three_input_family_source: A bitwise three-variable Boolean law applied across all four output positions; hidden true input-role wiring chosen privately from target/source previous/current and event fields. Family classes MAJORITY and conditional selection have different structure. No label or private source law is passed to models.
structural_holdout.out_of_scope_four_input_source: Bitwise 4-input nonlinear law on own_current, own_lagged, source_current and event, not expressible by any 3-input truth table; source-only negative that is never omitted even if CHECK fails.
structural_holdout.self_authorship_limit: Source author is internal synthetic source-only code, NOT external independent authenticator or real prospective scientific firstuse. No authentic external heldout source qualified.

frozen_arms.mechanism: Infer 2-input Boolean truth tables and wiring from meta supervised whole causal episodes; select a functionally complete learned gate (NAND/NOR) using a universal property check; infer previously unknown 3-input truth table/wiring from novel FIT only; compile this learned ternary function into a recursive Boolean circuit USING solely that meta-learned gate; CHECK/heldout eval circuit without true labels.

Independently infer Boolean operator truth tables from SAME 12 meta tasks and full novel FIT; use complete three-bit algebraic normal form as generic function class with learned coefficients and wiring, without candidate import. Do not weaken training.

Same candidate training data, sample count and sourcefree FIT, but no functionally complete learned gate retained; report inability to compile; ablation tests mechanism dependence, not competence superiority.
Original frozen learner on same novel public FIT; is a restricted historical control that receives no sourcefree meta training. Do not regard as a fair comparator.

equal_information: Primary candidate and independently implemented peer share all 12 public meta task episode sets and all 24 novel FIT sequences, same unknown hidden law and 8 CHECK veto-only cases. Arity-three search input triples fixed to 5 source-neutral public nibble registers, no labels passed from source generator; no heldout-driven algorithm or seed selection.
fairness_limits: Candidate compiler and ANF peer have different compute complexity and parameter counts; measure complete CPU/RSS in independent GitHub-hosted processes, but no resource nonregression claim unless matched native work.
natural_admission: Full supervised FIT exact over 192 x 8 x 4 bit observations per task; 8/8 complete CHECK trajectories exact without teacher forcing; 8 untouched positive + matched hard negative trajectories scored and hard false positive=0. All no-fit/no-check outcomes explicitly abstain.
resource_plan: Three synthetic heldout families × 4 seeds × 4 arms × 3 full Linux wait4 processes per model/case; 144 whole-process OS receipts; separate read-only audit of 6 original shards and exact equal-public episode hashes; Windows and Linux engineering preflight.
